records.question: What is the cap on liquidated damages for late delivery?
records.answer:
The cap on liquidated damages for late delivery is **10% of the delayed shipment value** [S1].

This applies if goods are delivered more than five business days late, at which point the Supplier must pay 0.5% of the delayed shipment value for each day of delay until the 10% limit is reached [S1].

retrieved_sources.text:
ACME SUPPLY AGREEMENT
Document ID: EVAL-CONTRACT-001
Section 12.2 Liquidated Damages
Marker: EVAL-C-12.2.
If Supplier delivers goods more than five business days late, Supplier must pay liquidated
damages equal to 0.5% of the delayed shipment value for each day of delay.
Liquidated damages are capped at 10% of the delayed shipment value.
Payment of liquidated damages does not limit Buyer's right to reject nonconforming goods.
Section 14. Confidentiality
Each party must protect the other party's confidential information using reasonable care and
may use it only to perform this agreement.
The confidentiality obligation survives for three years after termination.

ACME SUPPLY AGREEMENT
Document ID: EVAL-CONTRACT-001
Section 1. Parties
Buyer: Northwind Retail LLC. Supplier: Blue Harbor Components Ltd.
Section 2. Delivery
Supplier must deliver conforming goods to Buyer's Shanghai warehouse on or before the
delivery date stated in each purchase order.
A delivery is late if the goods arrive more than five business days after the applicable
delivery date.
Section 5. Payment
Buyer must pay undisputed invoices within 30 calendar days after receiving a valid invoice.
Disputed invoice amounts may be withheld until the dispute is resolved in writing by both
parties.

records.question: Does the agreement require Supplier to buy cybersecurity insurance?
records.answer:
The provided source excerpts do not contain any requirement for the Supplier to purchase cybersecurity insurance.

While Section 14 of the agreement mentions that each party must protect confidential information using "reasonable care," it does not specify insurance obligations or cybersecurity coverage [S2]. No other sections in the provided text address insurance requirements [S1], [S2].
